acceptance_basis: W01.4: numeric latency/memory/binary budget DIMENSIONS pre-registered before measuring/adoption; provisional numeric cutoffs are UNRATIFIED placeholders (same rule as accepted C05.1 shared/workloads.json): slower/bigger is data, never failure, until ratified from measured current-TS runs.
binary_budgets: TBD — no precedent and no measured data at Wave 1; any number now would be invented. Ratification point: W05.1 (pinned build:wasm + glue exist) for raw/compressed bytes; W05.3/W05.4 for staged-vendor bytes. Dimensions pre-registered: wasm bytes, compressed bundle delta, glue bytes, vendor inventory bytes.

dimensions.batch_plan_caches: max live planned-batch facts and plan-cache entries during wt-page/wt-501-member (bounded; exhaustion surfaces, never silently truncates membership/completion)
dimensions.binary_size: wasm + glue + vendor bytes (see binary_budgets: TBD until W05.1)
dimensions.complete_flows: wall-time distributions for complete turn, child-unit execution, and recovery sweep (wt-durable-turn; durable runs separate from CPU harness)
dimensions.compute_cold_warm: per-workload cold (first call incl. conversion) and warm compute; conversion/allocation reported separately from warm compute
dimensions.heap_linear_peak: heap peak (TS runs) and linear-memory peak (wasm runs); ref disposal verified (no retained refs after call return)
dimensions.host_demand: demand-pass cost (evidence reads, guard/grant/content evaluations) reported separately from kernel compute
dimensions.initialization: module load/verify/init time; cold/warm bootstrap distributions
dimensions.platform_startup: bundled consumer startup delta attributable to the kernel (measured at W05.3+, not Wave 1)

measurement_procedure: W07.2 complete-calls runner executes workloads.json shapes with --backend ts|prepared-ts|wasm, identical payloads/evidence/RNG sequences and host storage workloads; C05 local CPU harness for synchronous CPU (Worker performance clock is unreliable for sync CPU); separate wall-time durable runs; report distributions and variability, never single-helper timings or invented scores

provisional_cutoffs.note: UNRATIFIED placeholders mirroring accepted C05.1 orders of magnitude, not gates; comparisons against unratified cutoffs are forbidden

ratification_rule: W07.3 replaces each provisional cutoff with a measured ratified budget (from current-TS + prepared-TS runs, frozen before viewing Rust comparisons) or an explicit disabled-prototype scope; W08.1 adoption compares measured complete-call improvement over prepared TS against these ratified budgets
